headline: War in West Asia Triggers 1970s-Level Energy Crisis, Threatening Global Stability and Supply Chains.
summary: Reports of a US-Israel war on Iran are precipitating the biggest energy crisis since the 1970s, signaling a major geopolitical escalation with profound economic consequences. This will drastically increase costs for global logistics and manufacturing, directly impacting semiconductor fabs, AI infrastructure, and broader supply chain resilience due to elevated energy prices.
